title: Zero-Copy Stream
content:
Leverage Bun's native Bun.file() API within Photon to serve binary data without intermediate buffering in the JavaScript heap. This zero-copy approach provides exceptional performance for serving large files like videos, images, and documents.

Why Zero-Copy?

Traditional Node.js file serving approaches buffer data through JavaScript streams, causing:

  • 1Multiple context switches between JavaScript and native code
  • 2Memory allocation in the V8 heap for file chunks
  • 3Performance degradation with large files

Bun's Bun.file() passes file descriptors directly to the optimized C++ server, resulting in 0MB heap pressure regardless of file size.

Basic File Serving

The simplest way to serve a file:

import { Photon } from '@gravito/photon'

const app = new Photon()

app.get('/video/:id', async (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param('id')
  const file = Bun.file(`./assets/${id}.mp4`)
  
  // Check if file exists
  if (!(await file.exists())) {
    return c.text('File not found', 404)
  }
  
  // Return file directly (zero-copy)
  return new Response(file, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'video/mp4'
    }
  })
})

Automatic Content-Type Detection

Bun automatically detects MIME types from file extensions:

app.get('/image/:filename', async (c) => {
  const filename = c.req.param('filename')
  const file = Bun.file(`./public/images/${filename}`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    // Content-Type is automatically set based on file extension
    return new Response(file)
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

Custom Headers

Add custom headers for caching, download prompts, etc.:

app.get('/download/:filename', async (c) => {
  const filename = c.req.param('filename')
  const file = Bun.file(`./downloads/${filename}`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    return new Response(file, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=3600'
      }
    })
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

Range Requests (Video Streaming)

Video Streaming Support

Bun automatically handles HTTP Range requests for video streaming, enabling seamless seeking and playback.

app.get('/stream/:id', async (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param('id')
  const file = Bun.file(`./videos/${id}.mp4`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    // Bun automatically handles Range headers for video seeking
    return new Response(file, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'video/mp4',
        'Accept-Ranges': 'bytes',
        'Content-Length': file.size.toString()
      }
    })
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

Security: Path Validation

Security Warning

Always validate file paths to prevent directory traversal attacks.

app.get('/uploads/:filename', async (c) => {
  const filename = c.req.param('filename')
  
  // Prevent directory traversal
  if (!filename || filename.includes('..') || filename.includes('/')) {
    return c.text('Forbidden', 403)
  }
  
  // Sanitize filename
  const sanitized = filename.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '')
  const file = Bun.file(`./uploads/${sanitized}`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    return new Response(file)
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

File Metadata

Access file metadata before serving:

app.get('/file-info/:filename', async (c) => {
  const filename = c.req.param('filename')
  const file = Bun.file(`./files/${filename}`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    const stats = await file.stat()
    
    return c.json({
      name: filename,
      size: stats.size,
      type: file.type,
      lastModified: stats.lastModified
    })
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

Conditional Requests (ETag)

Implement efficient caching with ETags:

app.get('/asset/:filename', async (c) => {
  const filename = c.req.param('filename')
  const file = Bun.file(`./assets/${filename}`)
  
  if (await file.exists()) {
    const stats = await file.stat()
    const etag = `"${stats.lastModified}-${stats.size}"`
    
    // Check If-None-Match header
    if (c.req.header('If-None-Match') === etag) {
      return new Response(null, { status: 304 })
    }
    
    return new Response(file, {
      headers: {
        'ETag': etag,
        'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=31536000'
      }
    })
  }
  
  return c.text('Not found', 404)
})

Best Practices

  • ✓
    Always Check ExistenceUse await file.exists() before serving
  • ✓
    Validate PathsPrevent directory traversal attacks
  • ✓
    Set Content-TypeExplicitly set MIME types for better browser handling
  • ✓
    Use ETagsImplement conditional requests for efficient caching
  • ✓
    Range SupportLet Bun handle Range requests automatically for video streaming
  • ✓
    Security HeadersAdd appropriate security headers for file downloads

Performance: Zero-copy file streaming is one of Bun's killer features. For serving large media files, this approach provides 10-100x better performance compared to traditional Node.js streaming methods, with zero memory overhead.
